items.item_text: Bachelor's dress in Nursing or master's degree in nursing.
A minimum of 1 year of experience for BSN prepared RNs and a minimum of 6 months experience for MSN prepared RNs.
Knowledge and experience with phototherapy, laser treatments, and cosmetic dermatology including, botox, dermal fillers, and chemical peels consistent with role expectations and competency validation
Knowledge and experience in dermatologic surgical services, including Mohs surgery, excisions, biopsies, wound care, dressing changes, suture removal, and management of post-operative surgical sites

There’s nothing more exciting and rewarding than being able to make a significant, positive difference in someone’s life. At UCLA Health, you’ll experience this joy every day while also enjoying the positive, supportive, and collaborative environment that makes ours one of the most loved workplaces. Join us and find out for yourself.

The ambulatory dermatology clinical nurse is a professional Registered Nurse who assumes responsibility and accountability for designated dermatology patient panel across medical, surgical, & cosmetic services. The clinical nurse performs in the professional role as described by the American Nurses Association (ANA); engaging in activities related to ethics, education, evidence-based practice and research, quality improvement, leadership, collaboration, professional practice evaluation, resources utilization, environmental health, and patient advocacy as appropriate to clinical nursing practice. The Ambulatory Dermatology Clinical Nurse also practices in accordance with the American Academy of Ambulatory Nursing (AAACN) standards, incorporating the main nursing functions of patient care management, patient education, care coordination, triage, and support of patient transitions across the continuum of care. The nurse also supports and assists with dermatologic procedures, including patient preparation, procedural support, recovery, and post-procedure education.

At UCLA Health, passionate clinicians in a wide range of disciplines have enabled us to become a world-renowned health system with five award-winning hospitals and more than 300 community clinics throughout Southern California. We’re also home to the world-class medical research and clinical education capabilities of the David Geffen School of Medicine. If you’re looking to experience greater challenge and fulfillment in your career, come to UCLA Health.
Ability to complete & document comprehensive nursing assessment including skin assessment in dermatology clinic setting.
Skill in developing a plan of care including setting goals, monitoring and documenting progress
Ability to implement interventions that are pertinent to goals established in the plan of care
Ability to evaluate the effective of interventions toward the attainment of established goals and to recognize the need to reassess or reset goal parameters
Ability to delegate tasks in a management style that is consistent with promoting leadership and teamwork
Knowledge base to provide education to patients, families, and other staff regarding clinical and patient care issues
Knowledge and skill in focused skin assessment, recognition of dermatologic conditions and monitoring of treatment response
Knowledge of biologic treatment regimens, patient monitoring requirements, prior authorization coordination and patient education need
Ability to provide patient and family education related to skin care, sun safety, wound care, post procedure care, medication administration, and follow-up instructions
